summary.zh: AI 客户端可以按更多已验证条件筛选和排序白泽服务器节点，同时保持现有工具、登录方式与隐私保护结果兼容。
summary.en: AI clients can filter and sort Baize server agents with more verified conditions while keeping existing tools, sign-in, and privacy-protected outputs compatible.

zh: 支持按别名、系统、地区、架构、Agent 版本和分组筛选节点。
支持按创建时间、更新时间、最后心跳、注册时间、名称、状态、版本或系统排序。
保持三个只读工具名称、登录方式和结果字段边界兼容。
en: Filters agents by alias, system, region, architecture, Agent version, and group.
Sorts by creation time, update time, last heartbeat, registration time, name, status, version, or operating system.
Keeps the three read-only tool names, sign-in flow, and result field boundary compatible.

summary.zh: 通过安全的本机登录和三个只读工具，在 AI 软件、IDE 与终端客户端中查看经过隐私保护的白泽节点状态。
summary.en: Use secure local sign-in and three read-only tools to view privacy-protected Baize agent status from AI applications, IDEs, and terminal clients.

zh: 支持连接检查、节点分页列表和单节点基础状态。
支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 的 amd64 与 arm64 发布包。
发布包启动时自动校验可执行文件完整性。
en: Supports connection checks, paginated agent lists, and basic status for one agent.
Provides amd64 and arm64 archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Automatically verifies executable integrity at startup.
